lessons.title: Meet the conditioning lab
lessons.brief: A scene is data: plates, fixtures, props, an effects stack, emitters, and the characters placed in it — each with her consent record. This check passes when the conditioning lab validates against your project: every anchor part, hook parameter and dashboard binding resolves, and the consent records satisfy the pack model.

lessons.title: A room that breathes
lessons.brief: Ambient life is declared, not rendered by hand: drifting motes, light beams, a flicker, a color grade. The lab carries all of it as scene data.

lessons.title: Machines and rigs
lessons.brief: Fixtures anchor bodies to the room: the milking machine and the suspension rig declare anchor sets that name real parts of the character.

lessons.title: The visor
lessons.brief: Hooked props drive parameters: the trance visor's cycle closes her eyes toward trance, the suction cups ride the machine's cycle. A hook that names a parameter the puppet lacks is a validation error, never a silent no-op.

lessons.title: Fluids
lessons.brief: One deterministic simulation serves every fluid: the milk emitter's pressure pulses follow the same 2.4 s cycle the machine fixture declares, and landings read against the project's hit areas.

lessons.title: Capstone: the full lab
lessons.brief: Everything at once: the lab validates against your project and carries the whole archetype — machine, rig, visor, suction, dashboard, camera overlay, milk. Pass this and the Scenes track is complete.
